rules.name: Prefer tag over ARIA role
"Array.prototype.sort()" and "Array.prototype.toSorted()" should use a compare function
Nullish coalescing should be preferred
Cognitive Complexity of functions should not be too high
JSX list components should not use array indexes as key
Copyright and license headers should be defined in all source files
Avoid too many code lines in source file
Regular expression quantifiers and character classes should be used concisely
Redundant type aliases should not be used
If statements should not be the only statement in else blocks
Imports from the same module should be merged
Jump statements should not be redundant
Functions should not be empty
Type aliases should be used
Optional chaining should be preferred
All branches in a conditional structure should not have exactly the same implementation
Unused React typed props should be removed
Negated conditions should be avoided when an else clause is present
Use "globalThis" instead of "window", "self", or "global"
Class names should comply with a naming convention
Ternary operators should not be nested
Function names should comply with a naming convention
Redundant JSX fragments should be removed
Deprecated APIs should not be used
Unused assignments should be removed
Number literals should not have unnecessary decimal points or trailing zeros
Number static methods and properties should be preferred over global equivalents
Cognitive Complexity of functions should not be too high
Method names should comply with a naming convention
React props should be read-only
The return value of "useState" should be destructured and named symmetrically
Multiline blocks should be enclosed in curly braces
Files should not be too complex
Functions should not have identical implementations
Redundant casts and non-null assertions should be avoided
Functions should be moved to the highest possible scope
Avoid too many code lines in a single function
Two branches in a conditional structure should not have exactly the same implementation
Mouse events should have corresponding keyboard events
Functions should not have too many parameters
Statements should be on separate lines
Cognitive Complexity of methods/functions should not be too high
Non-interactive DOM elements should not have an interactive handler
Functions, methods and lambdas should not have too many parameters
Template literals should not be nested
"RegExp.exec()" should be preferred over "String.match()"
Multiple consecutive calls to methods that accept multiple arguments should be combined
Error parameters in catch clauses should follow a consistent naming convention
Promises should not be misused
Functions should not be nested too deeply
Non-interactive elements shouldn't have event handlers
Functions should not be too complex
Files should contain an empty new line at the end
Modern Math APIs should be used instead of legacy mathematical expressions
Lines of code should not be too long
Unnecessary imports should be removed
Spread syntax should not be used unnecessarily
